verdict.rationale: Twilio Video is a SaaS video API platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes are adjacent AI-readability features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
